routing: Bind queue operations to source video and native icon/recognized Elements row. Execute YTQueueController directly before acquisition dispatch, independent of hidden MDX alternatives or paired offer siblings. Preserve source entries in native Elements contexts; replace whole queue action or row, not just its outer callback.
presentation: Capture the native playlist panel update and capture Watch responses again after controller initialization; snapshot only native queue items into the existing engagement panel.
local_edits: Owned RVPortQueue section move/remove callbacks invoke native queue methods, avoiding remote playlist edits.
preservation: Unknown MDX shapes, active casting queues and unrelated playlist/video responses retain original behavior. No account entitlement value is changed.
live_baseline: Earlier delivered .67 did not resolve user-reported queue popup; no authenticated current-build call stack was available for .68.
observed_limit: Static implementation only; current device popup command and installed patched behavior are not observed. Elements text matching is limited to the listed English accessibility labels and individual listOption rows; singleContentElement whole menus remain native.
source_identity: Use selected source renderer video ID; never substitute current playback video for a missing target.
